annotations.title: Polish VAT refund deadline and input VAT deduction window

description: Use for when the Polish tax office must refund VAT (zwrot VAT, termin zwrotu VAT) after a JPK_V7 return, and for how many periods back input VAT can be deducted (odliczenie VAT). Give the inputs and the assumptions with the result. The result is a calculation from statutory rates. It is not advice. Last day for the Polish tax office to refund excess input VAT (zwrot VAT) under art. 87 of the VAT act, for the day the JPK_V7 return was filed: standard refund 40 days to the business bank account, 25 days to the VAT account (request in the return) or accelerated refund with paid invoices, 15 days for sellers with online cash registers counted from the return deadline (the 25th), 180 days when there were no taxable sales in the period, 60 days with a property security. Calendar days; the filing day is not counted and a deadline on a Saturday or public holiday moves to the next working day (Tax Ordinance art. 12). The tax office may extend the deadline to verify the refund; that is not included. Optional: the input VAT deduction window (art. 86(10)-(13)) for the month the right to deduct arose: the period itself and the next 3 months (2 quarters for quarterly filers) in the current return, with return deadlines, then a correction within 5 years from the start of that year.

deduction_month.description: Month the right to deduct input VAT arose (invoice received and tax point at the seller), YYYY-MM.

filed.description: Day the JPK_V7 return or correction was filed, YYYY-MM-DD.

variant.description: Refund type; omit to get all types sorted by deadline.
